$comment: Applied output of the cultural-calendar agent for May 2026 — Loudoun general-audience SMB (ChefScape). Not the default desi festival calendar; this client's primary_community is pan-loudoun-suburban so we lean US-calendar + AAPI Heritage Month + Loudoun-school-calendar.
seasonal_notes: Late spring — the outdoor-grill / patio / school-graduation / Memorial-Day-weekend cluster. LCPS last day of school is mid-June 2026; senior graduations are May 20–28. Loudoun farmer's markets re-open in earnest by May. Weather usually patio-friendly by mid-May.

hooks.name: Mother's Day
hooks.significance: Single-day; highest brunch-restaurant occupancy of the year.

food-hall: Mother's Day brunch — pre-fixe across three vendors, one ticket
Build-her-favorite cooking class — multiple cuisines, kids welcome
shared-kitchen: Vendor spotlight: the chefs cooking moms' favorites this weekend
Make-and-take: kids decorate dessert boxes, take home
event-venue: Booking note: Mother's Day brunch sold out / last seats — drives reservation urgency

do_not_say: celebrate the woman who does everything

hooks.name: Teacher Appreciation Week
hooks.significance: LCPS parents are organizing teacher lunches; first week of May is peak bulk-order volume for catering.

food-hall: Teacher Appreciation lunch trays — order Thursday, pick up Friday
Coffee + pastry bundle for early-week drop-off
shared-kitchen: Three vendor catering packages, one combined order

hooks.name: Asian American & Pacific Islander Heritage Month
hooks.significance: Cultural recognition month; the food hall has AAPI-owned vendors who should be foregrounded — not a generic 'celebrate diversity' post.

food-hall: Vendor profile: name + cuisine + the dish their amma / lola / halmoni taught them
Friday night feature: one AAPI vendor, one signature dish, one week
Cooking class with the vendor (Korean tteokbokki / Filipino lumpia / Vietnamese banh mi build)

hooks.name: Memorial Day weekend
hooks.significance: Three-day weekend; outdoor entertaining peak; grilling content peaks; many Loudoun families host. Strong driver for: grilling cooking class, food hall extended hours, group catering for backyard parties.

food-hall: Memorial Day weekend hours: open all three days
Grill-prep cooking class: marinades, rubs, plating — Saturday morning
Group platters to-go — order Wednesday, pick up Friday
shared-kitchen: Vendor BBQ pop-up on the hall floor Saturday afternoon
event-venue: Last call: Memorial Day weekend graduation parties — final two date slots

hooks.name: Loudoun school graduations
hooks.significance: Loudoun has 18+ high schools graduating in this window; graduation parties drive event-venue bookings and large catering orders.

event-venue: Graduation party packages — three sizes (25 / 50 / 100 guests)
Last two open Saturdays this month
food-hall: Graduation week cooking class for the kids before they head out
Graduation cake order window — 72 hours notice
